coatesgroup-coatesgroup:lever:28b2774c-2.description: Be Part of Our Next Chapter For over almost 60 years, our solutions have enabled impactful connections between some of the world’s leading brands and their customers. And while we’ve already done a lot of work we’re proud of, we’re just getting started! We’re a global technology company focused on creating dynamic, smart, personalized and engaging customer experiences powered by our range of digital hardware, our proprietary content management system and our industry leading signage solutions. (For example: If you’ve ordered in-store or in the drive-thru at McDonald’s somewhere in the world in the last few years, chances are you’ve interacted with our digital solutions.) We work in over 50 global markets and have 9 offices around the world, with a global headquarters proudly located in our founding home of Sydney, Australia. Coates Group has the values of a family-owned business and the innovative spirit of a start-up, both which fuel our purpose – Creating Connections. Empowering Partnerships. Always Evolving. Through hard work, dedication and creativity, we’ve become industry leaders who have won awards and set records while remaining focused on continual growth and evolution. We are a 2x Australia Good Design Award winner and successfully completed the largest hardware deployment in Quick Service Restaurant history. We are curious, charismatic, authentic and we value and leverage the diversity of our crew. We are imaginers, kindness enthusiasts, experts, creators, thinkers, challengers, collaborators and over-achievers. And together, as a Crew, we are revolutionizing the way the world’s leading brands leverage technology to drive the best customer experiences. The Benefits Administrator supports North America (NAM), including the U.S. and Canada, with primary responsibility for benefits and leave administration, policy management, and compliance. This role serves as the primary point of contact for employee benefits, managing enrollments, qualifying life event changes, vendor and broker coordination, employee questions, issue resolution, and benefits-related data entry across HiBob, ADP, carrier platforms, and related systems.The role also administers leaves of absence, coordinates global mobility activities for NAM, and creates, maintains, and administers People & Culture policies and processes. This position plays a key role in strengthening benefits administration, leave management, policy governance, compliance, and the overall employee experience.
responsibilities: Administers U.S. and Canada benefits programs and serves as the primary liaison among employees, benefits brokers, carriers, and vendors.
Responds to employee questions, resolves benefits issues, escalates complex matters as appropriate, and ensures employees receive timely and accurate information.
Administers leave-of-absence programs across the U.S. and Canada, including employee communications, documentation, case coordination, tracking, and compliance with applicable requirements.
Administers benefits enrollments, qualifying life event changes, terminations of coverage, and other benefits-related updates across HiBob, ADP, carrier platforms, and related systems.

Partners with the Senior Director, People & Culture, NAM on benefits renewals, plan design changes, employee communications, and ongoing administration to support market competitiveness and responsible stewardship of benefit spend.
Facilitates People & Culture Onboarding for new hires, coordinating orientation, resources, and helping to support the overall onboarding experience.
Partners with P&C team to support offboarding activities, including required benefits-related communications & compliance items.
Creates, maintains, and updates employee handbooks, policies, procedures, and related documentation to support compliance with applicable legal and business requirements.
Drives the administration and implementation of employee well-being and engagement initiatives for NAM.

Partners closely with payroll and finance to ensure benefits deductions, leave-related pay changes, and other benefits-related payroll updates and audits are processed accurately and on time. Provides backup support for NAM payroll processing as needed.

Responds to employee, manager, vendor, and external inquiries related to People & Culture policies, benefits, leaves of absence, and related processes.Supports People & Culture projects, benefits initiatives, compliance activities, and process improvements aligned with broader NAM, global, and functional priorities.Coordinates global mobility administration, including immigration documentation, case tracking, records maintenance, and timely coordination with Crew, managers, and external immigration partners.
qualifications: 7+ years of benefits administration or related Human Resources experience, including ownership of benefits programs for a mid-sized or larger organization.
Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
Working knowledge of U.S. and Canadian benefits, leave, employment, workplace safety, and anti-discrimination requirements.
Experience supporting employees and operations across the U.S. and Canada preferred.
Ability to manage competing priorities, work independently, adapt to changing needs, and meet deadlines with accuracy and accountability.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office and experience with HRIS, payroll, benefits, and carrier systems.
Ability to work on-site in the Chicago office at least three days per week.

cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:75.title: Project Management Technician
cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:75.description: Our client is a premier utility company specializing in rapid response and storm chasing to utility companies and contractors in need of a quick reaction force to repair power outages when they need it most. With a commitment to excellence and innovation, we provide reliable and efficient solutions to help our clients restore power quickly and effectively during emergencies and adverse weather conditions while ensuring operational efficiency and financial sustainability. Our customers are our communities, and when they need us, we are there. We are seeking a skilled and experienced Fleet Mechanic to maintain our fleet maintenance while supporting our rapid response and restoration services. The Fleet Operations Lead Mechanic will play a critical role in the upkept and readiness of our fleet of vehicles, equipment, and assets to ensure optimal performance, safety, and efficiency. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in commercial vehicle maintenance and maintenance schedules.
responsibilities: Fleet Maintenance:
Regularly review preventative maintenance schedules and ensure all vehicles are being maintained according to schedule
Diagnoses minor mechanical and electronic problems, utilizing diagnostic computer when applicable
Addresses all identified maintenance needs in an efficient manner while ensuring compliance with maintenance reporting requirements
Oversees and leads the emergency response maintenance and repairs as needed
Asset Availability & Utilization:
Ensure repairs are efficiently addressed to maintain asset availability for projects, jobs, and emergency responses.
Analyze asset data to identify opportunities for optimization, including right-sizing the fleet, improving asset utilization, and minimizing downtime.
Assist in developing preventive maintenance schedules and programs to extend the lifespan of fleet assets and reduce maintenance costs.
Equipment Safety and Compliance:
Assist in enforcing safety policies and procedures to ensure the safe operation of fleet vehicles and equipment.
Participate in regular safety training and inspections, addressing any safety concerns or violations promptly.
Assist in ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, including vehicle inspections, emissions testing, and driver licensing.
Emergency Response Support:
Assist in deploying fleet assets and personnel rapidly in response to emergencies and power outages.
Assist to ensure the readiness and availability of fleet resources during emergency situations.
Oversees and efficiently utilizes emergency mechanical support to ensure any mechanical opportunities are effectively addressed.
qualifications: Certifications in commercial fleet maintenance, as well as a minimum of 5 years proven fleet maintenance experience.
Strong knowledge of vehicle maintenance schedules, hands-on experience in diesel engine and/or heavy vehicle maintenance, diagnosis, repair, and safety compliance.
Excellent communication, and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
CDL Preferred

Whether the job entails interacting with our customers, driving digital growth, or providing vital behind-the-scenes support, we’re all here for the same reason – to roll up our sleeves and create happiness through cooking and sharing good food. Position Overview As a Sales Associateat Sur La Table, you play a key role in the success of the retail store by inspiring customers throughout every stage of their culinary experience. In this role, you’ll support daily operations, deliver a #bestincenter customer experience, a company-wide standard for excellence in service, and help drive sales by sharing product knowledge. Key Responsibilities Customer Experience & Brand Representation · Represent Sur La Table’s brand and culture by creating memorable, educational experiences that inspire repeat visits and customer loyalty · Maintains expertise by staying current on products, actively engaging in available training, and independently seeking out additional resources. · Actively engage customers, identify their needs, recommend relevant products or experiences, and leading a customer-focused, Guest Obsessed culture Sales & Business Performance · Maximize selling opportunities by identifying customer needs and offering relevant solutions. · Promote add-on sales and support events that grow store traffic and customer engagement. · Consistently meet or exceed monthly sales goals, contributing to overall store revenue. Performance is measured by key KPIs such as individual sales volume, average transaction value, and customer conversion rates. Team Engagement & Store Support · Collaborate with team members to maintain a positive, inclusive, and high-performing store culture · Support onboarding of new associates by sharing product knowledge and best practices Operations & Compliance · Accurately and efficiently process transactions including sales, returns, and price checks using the POS system. · Assist in daily opening and closing procedures, floor replenishment, and maintaining visual merchandising standards. · Complete inventory transactions including, but not limited to, receiving, MOS (Mark Out of Stock), and RARs (Return Authorization Requests). · Adhere to applicable wage and hour laws. Accurately records time worked according to SLT Policy · Models and ensures all Sur La Table policies and standard operating procedures (SOPs) are communicated effectively to associates, maintained and consistently followed. Physical Requirements · Ability to communicate verbally and work cooperatively with associates and customers · Ability to remain standing for up to 4 hours at a time · Ability to move about the store coaching and directing associates; selling to customers and retrieving merchandise from stockroom or sales floor · Ability to grab, reach, push, pull, bend, stoop, kneel, and crouch to retrieve and replenish merchandise from stockroom or sales floor. · Ability to lift and/or move merchandise weighing up to 50 lbs. · Ability to ascend/descend ladders to retrieve and/or move merchandise · Ability to operate a computer, POS system, keyboards, merchandise scanners and mouse to accomplish work · Available to work between 12 and 16 hours per week, with a flexible schedule, including nights, weekends, and holidays. While this is the minimum availability, scheduled hours may differ based on business needs. · Regular and predictable attendance Qualifications & Experience · Must be 18 years of age or older at the time of employment. · 1 year of retail sales experience preferred. · Excellent communication, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities. · Passion for community engagement and providing exceptional customer experiences. · Proficiency in Microsoft Office and retail management syst

jobgether-jobgether:lever:4ae6ac00-90a8-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Accounts Receivable & Revenue Operations Specialist based in Ireland. This role offers the opportunity to take ownership of critical revenue operations within a fast-paced, remote startup environment. You will manage the revenue cycle end-to-end, ensuring accuracy and efficiency from quoting through collections. The position combines accounts receivable expertise with systems optimization, reporting, automation, and process improvement. You will work closely with accounting, sales, and customers to resolve billing issues and maintain strong financial operations. Your ability to identify discrepancies, improve workflows, and strengthen financial controls will directly support business growth. The role is ideal for a proactive finance professional who enjoys autonomy, problem-solving, and evolving priorities. You will have the opportunity to contribute to scalable processes while working with modern accounting and payment technologies. Lead end-to-end revenue operations, covering quote generation, invoicing, reconciliation, receivables tracking, and timely collections. Review invoices and billing information against order forms, investigate discrepancies, and coordinate resolutions with sales teams and customers. Respond to customer and sales inquiries regarding invoices, billing issues, and payment status while taking ownership of the collections process. Support accurate revenue reporting by collaborating with accounting teams and reviewing SQL query outputs for accuracy and consistency. Manage and optimize financial systems such as QuickBooks Online and Stripe, including system upgrades, automation initiatives, and workflow improvements. Identify opportunities to streamline revenue processes, strengthen operational controls, and improve the overall quote-to-cash cycle. Communicate clearly and professionally with customers and internal stakeholders regarding billing, collections, and financial matters. Work independently while maintaining strong collaboration with accounting, sales, and other operational teams. Requirements 2+ years of accounting experience within U.S.-based companies, with a strong focus on Accounts Receivable and Revenue Operations. Demonstrated experience managing the complete revenue cycle from quote to cash. Advanced proficiency with QuickBooks Online and Stripe, with the ability to review SQL query outputs and identify potential inaccuracies. Strong reconciliation and problem-solving skills, including the confidence to challenge discrepancies and push back appropriately with customers or sales teams. Experience implementing process improvements, system upgrades, and automation projects within accounting or revenue operations. Familiarity with startup accounting environments and the ability to adapt effectively to changing priorities. Experience with tools such as Slack, Google Drive, Google Sheets, Mercury, Chase, Ramp, Brex, Bill.com, or ClickUp is a plus. Professional fluency in English, with strong written and verbal communication skills. Highly organized, detail-oriented, proactive, and trustworthy, with a strong sense of ownership and integrity. Comfortable working independently while also contributing effectively within a collaborative team. Coachable and eager to continuously improve processes, systems, and professional capabilities. General awareness of how AI is being applied to accounting and operational workflows is an advantage. Benefits Competitive salary paid in USD per month, based on experience. jobgether-jobgether:lever:a69a08d8-2199-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Principal Software Engineer Lead based in India. This is a senior technical leadership opportunity focused on building secure, resilient solutions for enterprise-scale digital environments. You will guide the design and implementation of network and security capabilities while influencing product architecture across a global engineering organization. The role combines hands-on software engineering, security architecture, technical leadership, and cross-functional collaboration. You will help ensure products meet demanding security standards, including FedRAMP and NIST-aligned requirements, while addressing evolving threats and vulnerabilities. You’ll work closely with engineering, product, audit, vulnerability assessment, penetration testing, and sales engineering teams. This is an opportunity to shape security solutions that protect critical digital experiences used at extraordinary global scale. Lead the design and implementation of secure network and security solutions, translating business and technical requirements into scalable functional designs. Establish, maintain, and promote security standards, procedures, guidelines, and engineering practices across the product portfolio. Evaluate network, security, cloud, and related technologies and recommend solutions aligned with industry best practices and applicable regulatory requirements. Identify security and network risks within existing architectures and implementations and drive effective remediation strategies. Collaborate with development, product, support, sales engineering, architecture, and other stakeholders to integrate security into product design and development. Monitor emerging developments across networking, cloud, security, and software engineering and translate relevant advances into product and architectural improvements. Contribute to technical strategy, design decisions, and continuous improvement within a globally distributed engineering environment. Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline, combined with 12+ years of relevant professional experience. Extensive expertise in networking protocols and technologies, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, and VLANs, with demonstrated experience designing and deploying secure network infrastructure. Strong knowledge of VPN technologies, virtual appliances, hypervisors, cloud platforms, and identity and access management protocols and tools. Deep understanding of security standards, frameworks, and best practices, including familiarity with NIST standards and FedRAMP compliance requirements. Proficiency in one or more programming languages such as C, C++, Python, or Go, with a strong focus on secure software development. Experience designing and developing both on-premises and cloud-based appliances, including the ability to identify and address associated security challenges. Strong understanding of network and application security architecture, threat identification, vulnerability management, and risk mitigation. turnriver-turn-river:ashbyhq:f0577244-0f.title: VP, Customer Retention
turnriver-turn-river:ashbyhq:f0577244-0f.description: ABOUT TURN/RIVER Turn/River Capital is a private equity firm that applies a proprietary growth engineering strategy to investing, partnering with software businesses to accelerate growth and build enduring value. The firm’s team of equal parts investors and operators provides hands-on operational support and the flexible capital to systematically scale marketing, sales and customer success at its portfolio companies. Founded in 2012 and based in San Francisco, Turn/River has $5.6bn in committed capital and invests globally with a focus on North America and Europe. About the Role Turn/River is seeking a VP, Customer Retention to work directly with the leadership teams at our portfolio companies to build and execute retention and growth strategies. This hire will focus on diagnosing where net revenue retention is leaking, deploying the systems that fix it, and installing those systems across 2–3 companies at a time. You will bring deep operating expertise across every core CS function — renewals, expansion, customer success, onboarding, support, and professional services — and apply it in service of one outcome: portfolio companies that retain and grow their customer base better than they did before we invested. You know how to read a cohort curve and tell the difference between a product problem and a coverage problem. You know how to rebuild an onboarding motion that isn't producing measurable value . And you have enough fluency in pricing, packaging, and CS tooling to earn the trust of a CCO and a CFO in the same conversation. This is a hands-on, high-impact role for someone who works through other people's teams, thrives in ambiguity, and can move between diligence, strategy, and in-the-weeds execution in the same week. Key Responsibilities - Partner with CEOs and CS leaders at 2-3 portfolio companies to diagnose retention performance and deploy prioritized, known good tactics. - Install operational best practices across the CS organization — segmentation, coverage models, health scoring, escalation paths, and renewal motions. - Define the CS reporting and tracking layer: the metrics, dashboards, and cadence leadership uses to run the business and that Turn/River uses to measure progress. - Advise on pricing and packaging changes, and partner with CS leaders to execute the customer-facing rollout without eroding retention. - Deploy and iterate onboarding and adoption programs, including the collateral, playbooks, and enablement assets required to make them repeatable. - Partner with CS leaders to recruit, assess, and develop their teams — including defining role profiles, interview processes, and performance expectations. - Lead portfolio-wide CS training and drive a shared learning culture across companies. - Contribute new playbooks and content to the Turn/River CS library so wins at one company become defaults across the portfolio. - Provide CS and retention diligence on prospective investments, including a clear view of retention risk and the value creation opportunity. Qualifications - 10+ years leading customer success organizations, with direct ownership across all core CS pillars: renewals, expansion, onboarding, support, and professional services. - 5+ years in B2B SaaS, with a demonstrable track record of improving gross and net revenue retention — specific numbers, before and after. - Proven experience executing and iterating onboarding programs, recurring guided success / adoption cycles, and retention processes end to end, not just advising on them. - Ability to enter an unfamiliar business, diagnose the drivers of churn and retention, and deploy our playbooks based on the needs and priorities of each customer base. - Demonstrated ability to influence without authority — driving change through leadership teams you don't manage. - Depth in the CS tooling stack sufficient to evaluate, select, and implement systems, not just operate within them. Location - San Francisco, hybrid work model Compensation - The annual

As the global leader and pioneer of the mobile webcomic format, WEBTOON Entertainment has transformed comics and visual storytelling for fans and creators. With its CANVAS UGC platform empowering anyone to become a creator, and a growing roster of superstar WEBTOON Originals creators and series, WEBTOON Entertainment’s passionate fandoms are the new face of pop culture. WEBTOON Entertainment adaptations are available on Netflix, Prime Video, Crunchyroll, and other screens around the world, and the company’s content partners include Discord, HYBE, and DC Comics, among many others.
